'''Undar''' was an [[Atmosphere/Legends|airless]] terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]. It occupied the third [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Darlo/Legends|Darlo]] and had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Along with the rest of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], Undar was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Undar was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA" />
